blocks.title: Kavya × Karan/Aman — first conscious romantic/physical bridge
actions: This is a follow-up to their actual introduction on 1 Jan, NOT their first-ever encounter. Kavya is Shivani's adult younger sister; she did not witness all private details of Shivani and the brothers, and is not omniscient.
Natural entry: the three cross paths in the shared society courtyard/foyer returning from normal errands. No new rehearsal, forced Biology tutoring or identical office/society setup.
Kavya recognizes both brothers' separate interest. She starts witty teasing herself, asking how each of them plans to distinguish himself rather than making a generic 'same twins' recognition joke.

First PHYSICAL BRIDGE, her own chosen gesture: Kavya reaches toward both brothers' hands, each accepts a brief mutually welcome handhold; while walking a short stretch, she hooks an arm lightly with each. This is public, ordinary clothed affectionate contact, not a kiss or garment slip.

Karan responds with an openly teasing line and playful pace; Aman answers more sparingly but unexpectedly directs a personal observation to Kavya, causing her to look back at him even after they let go. She thought she controlled the joke; she now notices genuine different chemistry with each.

They exchange a practical way to communicate—individual phone contacts or a shared group chat only if each willingly agrees—allowing later meetings without contrived assignments. Kavya's pre-existing Deepu spark stays real; no exclusive relationship with anyone is declared.

Knowledge: Shivani learns only what is actually shared; she does not silently witness the touch. Karan/Aman keep the earlier Shivani encounter history separate. Three-person first bridge is a PLOT PROPOSAL, not final author-locked prose.

actions: 16:00 onwards: Shivani, Pooja, Kriti and Aarav work sincerely on biology/science-communication seminar materials, slides, teaching models and delivery; students do not attend. Aarav remains English faculty, not an invented Biotechnology professor.

Their previous refusal of clothing/neckline inspection remains valid; no kiss or further intimacy is assumed.

Pooja's style: expressive and spontaneous, she responds with familiar consensual closeness and playful conversation; Kriti's style: deliberate, gives Aarav an independent close handhold/face-to-face challenge rather than copying Pooja. Their existing bolder history is not reset to first touch.
